title: Limestones
tagline: A new Web3 music ecosystem that will help democratize access to music nfts in the caribbean region. We also aim to create better standards for music nfts using best in class principles & concepts.
description: Our project focuses on creating a better user interface as well as support for caribbean artists in the nft space. We also aim to improve on the current offering that exist in the web3 music ecosystem. We offer minting as a service using zora protocol. Web3 Music Playlist for songs minted through our platform. Link in-bio features & social media sharing capability. USDC payment integration for social tipping.
how_its_made: We built this project using photoshop, figma, & zora protocol as our main tech stack. We used zora to mint the nft but focused on the visual design of the music NFT to ensure it connects with the artists audience. We integrated web2 UI into the visual design of the nft itself. This was the pause/play button and moments "title". When people see the music nft they can easily understand this as music. We also plan on integrating spinamp as a partner to increase sharing and social components of the music nfts. With neume.network we plan on bringing caribbean genres onchain by indexing them. #Dancehall #Afroswing. We also plan on partnering with nft.storage to ensure best in class storage is used to create immutable nfts.
